description: Contract of the free design lane (round 3 close): the Art Director composes an inner slide by hand as sanitized HTML + scoped CSS in slide.free, and the engine renders it inside the preset's own chrome. Both engines read this one file: the JavaScript compose and sanitizer, the Python validator. Anything not listed here is removed (HTML) or refused (CSS).
appliesTo: every slide type except cover; the cover keeps the approved engine designs

fields.description: An element with data-field is filled with that slide field through the normal text pipeline (word spans, bidi isolation, the post's digit system), so Studio text editing and the copy gates keep working. Literal text is allowed elsewhere and goes through the same pipeline.

mark.note: drawn around or under the element that carries it, after fitting, in the preset's hand

tone.note: on a container: paints it with that tone's ground and ink from the resolved tokens

chat.note: on a p or div inside a container with class f-chat: a chat bubble on the end side (me) or the start side (them)

css.scope: every selector is prefixed with .cs-slide[data-cs-slide="<id>"] .cs-free; selectors may use classes, the allowed tags, attribute selectors on the allowed attributes, :first-child, :last-child, :nth-child() and ::before/::after with content of quoted text or ""
css.arabicRules: never letter-spacing, word-spacing on Arabic, font-style italic or oblique, text-align justify, or opacity on text; fonts come from the preset (font-family may only be var(--cs-font-display), var(--cs-font-heading), var(--cs-font-body) or var(--cs-font-latin)); colours should use the resolved tokens var(--cs-*) so a brand or tone change still works
css.notes: background accepts a colour or linear-gradient(<angle>deg, ...) only (the replay painter draws nothing else); position fixed and sticky are refused; transform takes rotate, scale and translate only
css.tokens: colours: --cs-bg --cs-surface --cs-ink --cs-ink-muted --cs-accent --cs-on-accent --cs-line and the art supports --cs-art-s1 --cs-art-s2; type sizes: --cs-fs-hero --cs-fs-title --cs-fs-h --cs-fs-body --cs-fs-small --cs-fs-micro; spacing: --cs-gap --cs-unit

qa: Free slides skip the planner gates (VA*, D8.anchor-run). They keep every safety gate: D2 overflow and outside-content, D3 size floors (body at least 42 px, nothing under 30 px), D4 contrast, D5 Arabic rules, D9 dead space, C2 text-dropped and text-duplicated, the copy gates on the slide's text (fields plus literal text).
